Priya Rao: FYI we just confirmed Naomi Park (Sr PM) for an onsite Thurs 4/10. She's on EST, requested earliest slot possible. Also noted mobility-accessible room and captioning for video follow-up.
Sam Patel: Adding panel: Ava (hiring mgr), Jordan (infra), me (product). Can we do 9:002:30 ET with a 30m buffer? Prefer 9:30 start.
Jordan Lee: I'll check room availability. Need: accessible elevator access, small round table for whiteboarding, A/V with captions enabled.
Priya Rao: Candidate asked about vegetarian lunch option and whether we can cover parking or transit. Please include travel reimbursement link and note dietary preference.
IT Support: For captioning we can enable live captions on Zoom and also book our CART vendor if Naomi needs verbatim captioning. CART requires 48hr lead. Please confirm ASAP.
Ava Chen: I've got the interview agenda draft. Will post once rooms confirmed. Also can host part of pairing remotely if needed.
Sam Patel: Recruiter note: Naomi requested a 30-min relaxed intro with hiring manager before technical loop. Can we slot that at 9:30 PT?
Priya Rao: Yes. Proposed calendar text:
```
Subject: Redwood Onsite 1 Naomi Park (Sr PM)
When: Thu 4/10, 9:3014:00 ET
Location: HQ 0th fl Suite + Zoom (link)
Agenda:
  09:309:55 Intro w/ Hiring Mgr (Ava)
  10:0511:00 Product deep-dive (Sam)
  11:1512:00 Cross-functional panel (Jordan)
  12:0013:00 Lunch (provided)
  13:1513:45 Stakeholder sync + debrief prep
Notes: Candidate prefers vegetarian lunch. Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible room reserved. Captioning vendor requested. Parking validated at Visitor Lot A. Reimbursement form: https://redwood.pay/reimburse
```
Jordan Lee: Room booked: 20B (wheelchair accessible) 09:0016:00. A/V unit booked. I'll add Zoom fallback link.
Priya Rao: CART captioning requested just now for 09:1514:15. TalentOps, can you confirm vendor availability?
TalentOps Bot: CART vendor availability: PROV-CART 7 registered. Tentatively booked pending human confirmation.
Sam Patel: I'll DM vendor contact and confirm meal accommodations with office cafe. Also Naomi told me she prefers a quiet space for break between loops. Can we reserve a small lounge?
Jordan Lee: Reserve Quiet Room Q3 12:0013:30. Marked as 'candidate break'.
IT Support: Zoom meeting created with live captions enabled. CART vendor contact and phone added to invite notes. If loaner laptop needed, file: `laptop-request: Naomi Park | 4/10 | MacOS | loaner`.
Priya Rao: I'll send final invite with reimbursement link and dietary note by EOD Tue. Also will include parking instructions: validation code at lobby.
Ava Chen: Quick ask for panelists: please fill the interview rubric before debrief: https://redwood.internal/rubrics/srpm. Share any accommodation questions in-thread.
Priya Rao: Closing checklist: rooms + Zoom (Jordan), CART captioning (Sam -> vendor), lunch + dietary (Sam/Facilities), quiet room (Jordan), loaner laptop (IT Support), invite + reimbursement link (Priya). I'll post candidate thread in #interviews after invites.
Sam Patel: Thanks 1 will follow up with vendor and cafe. :thumbsup:
